## Connect

Use your repository's REST API URL, not its website homepage:

```{r connect, eval=FALSE}
library(dspacer)

con <- ds_connect("https://repository.example.org/server/api")
```

For public content, you can use this anonymous connection without logging in.

## Log in

Set `DSPACE_USER` and `DSPACE_PASSWORD` in your environment before running this
example, for instance in a private `.Renviron` file. Keep credentials out of
scripts and version control.

```{r login, eval=FALSE}
ds_login(
  con,
  user = Sys.getenv("DSPACE_USER"),
  password = Sys.getenv("DSPACE_PASSWORD")
)

con
```

Printing `con` shows whether it is authenticated without displaying credentials.
Use this same connection for subsequent requests.

This supports DSpace username/password authentication, not browser-based SSO.
Logging in does not grant access beyond your account's existing permissions.

## Disconnect

When finished, log out and clear the local session:

```{r disconnect, eval=FALSE}
ds_disconnect(con)
```

Do not save `con` with your research data: it contains sensitive session state.
